entities.summary: Aman Hambleton is a Canadian chess grandmaster, Twitch/Kick streamer, and Youtube content creator. He is a member of the 'Chessbrahs', along with other grandmasters such as Eric Hansen (founder), Robin van Kampen, and Yasser Seirawan.
